text: [225] 21 tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse . katamehi tīhi amamā apariggahā niyatāyukā visesabhuno 3 . imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi #1 ma. nādo . 2 ma. kulaṃ mettā . 3 ma. visesaguṇā . uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse . tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi devā tāvatiṃsā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse . katamehi tīhi dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena . imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi devā tāvatiṃsā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse . tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi jambudīpakā manussā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti deve ca tāvatiṃse . katamehi tīhi sūrā satimanto idha brahmacariyavāso . imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi jambudīpakā manussā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti deve ca tāvatiṃseti .
